description: List the types a secret group can have, each with its fields in order: field key, label (which carries the expected format, e.g. 'Expiry (MM/YY)'), whether it is required, and whether it is masked. Call before muggle-remote-secret-group-create or muggle-remote-secret-group-update. Response shape: [{ secretType, label, fields: [{ field, label, isRequired, isMasked }] }].
name: muggle-remote-secret-type-list
